CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT MAHAJAN  ORDER % 06.11.2025 1.

By the present petition, the petitioners seek quashing of FIR No. 310/2015 dated 04.04.2015,
registered at Police Station Kalyanpuri, for offences under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.
The FIR was registered pursuant to a complaint given by Respondent No. 2 alleging cruelty by the petitioners.
3. Petitioner No. 1 was the husband of Respondent No. 2 and Petitioner Nos. 2 to 4 are the relatives of Petitioner No. 1.

4. The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the FIR was registered as a counterblast to the divorce proceedings initiated by Petitioner No. 1.
5.
He submits that the learned Trial Court, after hearing the parties, has already passed a decree of divorce on the ground of This is a digitally signed order.

7. Issue notice.
8. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State accepts notice.

9. Notice to Respondent No. 2 be served through all permissible modes.
10.
